assets.Forest: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual wide background plate for a Unity 2D side-scrolling Vietnamese folklore platformer. Create a 1536x1024 landscape image of an enchanting nocturnal ancient banyan forest, layered distant mountains and graceful tree trunks, tiny Vietnamese pagoda roof silhouettes deep in the distance, suspended tiny fireflies, mist in the low valleys, a broken crescent moon high at upper right. Beautiful deliberate pixel art, visible crisp square pixel clusters, sophisticated restrained deep indigo, petrol blue, teal, jade, pale mint and small amber lights palette, atmospheric cinematic composition. This is a BACKGROUND ONLY: no protagonist, no monsters, no UI, no lettering, no logo, no walkable foreground platforms. Dark tree framing at left and right, open breathing room in center and lower middle where gameplay overlays will be. All layers softly separated in value while the pixels themselves are crisp. Polished independent game art, magical and melancholic, not horror. Horizontal screen-friendly composition, no blur, no gradients that erase the pixel texture.
assets.Cuoi: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game-ready transparent sprite animation atlas for Unity. EXACT layout: 1024x1024 square canvas, 4 columns x 4 rows of equally sized 256x256 cells, 16 frames total, no gutters, no text or grid lines. One same Vietnamese folklore hero Chu Cuoi in every cell, facing RIGHT in strict side view. Young man with black hair, simple indigo/teal peasant tunic, brown trousers, red waist sash, small straw conical hat pushed back on head, barefoot, holding a small glowing amber paper lantern on his forward right hand. Readable cute but adventurous 2D pixel-art character, each figure visually about 120px wide by 170px tall in its 256px cell. Anchor his feet consistently at y=220 within each cell and center body at x=110; include lantern to right. Row1: four subtle breathing idle frames. Row2: four clearly different running cycle poses, alternating legs and arms. Row3: four jump poses: crouched anticipation, rising tucked knees, airborne apex, landing bent knees. Row4: four lantern raise activation poses, lantern lifted higher on successive frames, do not draw surrounding glow outside the cell. Consistent same sizes, clothes and features, crisp hand-placed square pixels, limited palette with dark outline, rich turquoise shading and warm amber accents matching a nocturnal banyan forest. Transparent background genuine alpha. No floor, no shadows separate from character, no labels, no external effects, no duplicate characters inside a cell. Production sprite atlas, not a concept sheet.
